# TopologyAware_SpikeRouting

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing mechanism in iNEST that uses TCC-derived topological metrics (e.g., Betti numbers, persistent homology) to dynamically steer spike packets through network paths. This optimizes latency and energy efficiency by exploiting the underlying network's shape rather than relying on static routing tables.
